svg.text: Square pad = pad 1: the cathode of a diode or an LED, the plus of an electrolytic, pin 1 of a header.
Grey and unlabelled: the commonest resistor of the card (see the legend) and the 2N7000, flat side as the outline shows. Resistors stand upright on 5.08 mm.
DIP switches (black pads, named on the silkscreen): a closed switch (ON) is RUN, an open one STEP. They work either way round: fit each with ON toward the right edge.
Drawn from the committed board by sim/assembly.py; the values are the schematic's. Front view, the header along the top edge.
